title: 3D Print Arena
description: 3D Print Arena, also known as 3D Print Battles (3DPrintBattles), is a collectible card battler of 3D-printed creatures. Open packs, build a deck, and print your army onto the arena.
controls: Mouse or touch: play cards from your hand, then pick what your creatures attack
requirements: WebGL2; about a 130 MB download the first time
